description: Reviewed dispositions of the LiveCharts2 port. Each part of the port (L1 and later, docs/porting/livecharts2.md) adds the dispositions it implements; a `ported` or `native-replacement` entry names the Rust files that implement it.

src/LiveChartsCore/BarSeries.cs.reason: The shared Rust measurement pipeline implements orientation, bar grouping, pivot, signed stacks, range endpoints, errors, max width and exact-vs-category hover separation.
remaining: Generic visual/lifecycle template hooks and the complete source label placement/padding contract remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/CartesianChartEngine..reason: Pure measurement calculates independent axes, visible data bounds, signed stacks, grouped bars, sections and retained FerroUI geometry; native host supplies observed data, cached scenes and pointer zoom, pan and section selection.
remaining: Source fit-to-data/bounce behavior and shared chart event synchronization are not implemented.
The full measuring/update lifecycle, throttling, draw-margin-defined callbacks and all source public methods are not yet represented.
Auto margins use fixed axis bands rather than the complete source text-measured separator/name layout.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreAxis.cs.reason: Native axis snapshot preserves labels, named axes, limits, position, inversion, spacing, unit width, text styling and logarithmic scales; AxisScale handles extreme finite linear domains and inverse conversion.
remaining: Source custom label callbacks, tick/subtick geometry, crosshairs, min/max zoom range and the full text-measured padding contract are not implemented.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreBoxSeries.cs.reason: Five-statistic boxes render extrema, quartiles, median and whiskers; hover includes the category slot and labels carry the statistics.
remaining: Source independent box-series grouping and all whisker/label options remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreColumnSeries.cs.reason: Vertical bars use category widths, maximum pixel width, spacing, pivot, native rounded rectangles, clipping and full category hover.
remaining: Source variable geometry factories and all label/series padding properties remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreFinancialSeries.c.reason: OHLC coordinates render candlesticks, wicks, bullish/bearish defaults, full category hover and all OHLC values in tooltip text.
remaining: Separate UpFill/DownFill/UpStroke/DownStroke properties, generic financial visuals and all source data label placement behavior remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreHeatLandSeries.cs.reason: Lands, HeatMap (the two blues of the source by default), ColorStops, MinValue, MaxValue, WeightBounds and TryGetValue; the heat of each land of the default layer by its key, a later series over an earlier one, a land of a departed series back to the chart fill (issue 962), and the observation of the lands. A hidden series paints nothing and has no tooltip value, where the source measures every series; a land without a finite value is not painted.
remaining: IsVisibleAtLegend and the heat legend source (SKHeatLegend).

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreHeatSeries.cs.reason: Heat cells infer numeric/date spacing, bound each series independently, interpolate uniform palettes and expose weight in data/tooltip labels.
remaining: Source explicit color stops, cell padding, source weight-bound overrides and all data label styles remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreLineSeries.cs.reason: Line/spline, filled and stacked area tracks, signed and 100% stacks, geometry markers, errors, null splitting, native style and category hover.
remaining: Source generic custom visuals, per-point styling hooks, exact coordinate-space spline controls and all data-label placements remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/CorePieSeries.cs.reason: Pie layout preserves the source absolute/relative minimum gauge branches, saturation, fill background, gauge hover-space exclusion, signed diameter offsets, concentric empty slots, relative radii, maximum radial width/alignment and five label positions using host font metrics. Native cubic paths support rounded and inverted corners.
remaining: HoverPushout reserves the correct layout space but pointer-driven pushout animation is not yet wired.
Tangent/cotangent text-angle flags, all custom formatters and source generic geometry lifecycle remain pending.
Rounded tiny wedges clamp corners before edge overlap; full rings remain exactly closed instead of upstream 359.99-degree approximation. PNG equivalence has not been claimed.

src/LiveChartsCore/CorePolarAxis.cs.reason: Angle separators run from the inner to the outer radius and radius separators are circles; the ticks use the polar nice step, custom separators and logarithmic bases; labels are placed at LabelsAngle with the tangent and cotangent rotation flags and kept upright.
remaining: Axis names, label backgrounds, sub-separators and the animated separator lifecycle are not ported.

src/LiveChartsCore/CorePolarLineSeries.c.reason: The source spline of a polar line (open or closed, null splitting), its area filled with the theme's alpha 50, stacked radii, the five data label positions with the rotation flags, markers and hover areas.
remaining: The geometry fill and stroke paints of the markers and the per-point animation of the source segments are not ported; markers take the series paint.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreRangeColumnSeries.reason: Vertical range bars include both endpoints in bounds, including reversed ranges, and show both values in tooltip labels.
remaining: Source full-span tick padding and all range data-label formatting/placement options remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreRangeLineSeries.c.reason: Dual high/low paths form a filled band, both endpoint markers are rendered, exact hits target either marker and category hover covers the entire band.
remaining: Source full-span tick padding, complete data label layout, generic geometry and per-point lifecycle remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreRangeRowSeries.cs.reason: Horizontal/Gantt range bars include both endpoints, preserve the axis swap and support numeric/date-sized categories.
remaining: Source automatic DateTime formatter integration and full-span tick padding remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreRowSeries.cs.reason: Horizontal bars swap category/value axes, preserve range bounds and use orientation-correct hover and error geometry.
remaining: Source variable geometry factories and all label/series padding properties remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreSankeySeries.cs.reason: Vertical and bipartite arc measurement: node rectangles and arc sectors with the corner radius, ribbons and chords under the nodes, the ribbon paint (link colour, then the source node colour at half alpha, then LinkFill, then the theme's LinkFill at alpha 90; a null LinkFill takes the node fill), Auto, Outside and Inside labels with the room they reserve and the radial label margin, and rectangle and annular sector hover areas with the default tooltip text.
remaining: The per-node, per-ribbon and per-label visual lifecycle of the source (entrance at zero size, exit collapse) is replaced by the native scene transition.
LabelMapper, NodeColorMapper, LinkColorMapper and ToolTipLabelFormatter delegates are replaced by the node names and the colours of nodes and links; DataLabelsMaxWidth wrapping is not ported.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreScatterSeries.cs.reason: Scatter bubbles interpolate diameter from tertiary weights, render native glyphs/errors and preserve hit identities across remeasurement.
remaining: Shared source weight-bounds grouping, arbitrary geometry factories and complete per-point styling hooks remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreStackedColumnSeri.reason: Vertical stacks retain independent positive/negative accumulators, category/axis/group keys and optional 100% normalization.
remaining: Source custom visual lifecycle, every stack-position behavior and data label placement require further parity fixtures.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreStackedRowSeries..reason: Horizontal stacks preserve sign-specific accumulators, axis orientation, stack groups and optional 100% normalization.
remaining: Source custom visual lifecycle, every stack-position behavior and data label placement require further parity fixtures.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreStepLineSeries.cs.reason: Step paths, filled/stacked step areas, signed and 100% stacking, gaps, markers and category hover.
remaining: Source generic custom visuals, per-point lifecycle hooks and complete label-placement options remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/CoreTreemapSeries.cs.reason: The weight roll-up (a nonzero explicit value, else the sum of the children), the padding inset of every level, tiles in the order of the source, hover areas and centred data labels culled when they do not fit on the leaves only, and the leaf that becomes internal losing both.
remaining: ValueMapper, ChildrenMapper, LabelMapper and the tooltip formatter of a custom model are not ported: the native TreemapNode is the model.
The per-tile visual lifecycle of the source is replaced by the native scene transition; DataLabelsMaxWidth wrapping is not ported.

src/LiveChartsCore/Defaults/SankeyLink.c.reason: A notifying link that refers to its Source and Target node objects, with its Weight; its Color stands for the LinkColorMapper of the source series.

src/LiveChartsCore/Defaults/SankeyNode.c.reason: A notifying node with its Name; its Color stands for the NodeColorMapper of the source series.

src/LiveChartsCore/Defaults/TreemapNode..reason: A notifying node with its Name, Value and nullable Children (null is a leaf, an empty list an internal node); a node that contains itself is an error.

src/LiveChartsCore/Drawing/Animation.cs.reason: Owned animation options replace shared mutable animation state: duration uses caller clock milliseconds, Rc closure carries easing, Repeat enum expresses finite/infinite repeats. Repeat counters live on each motion property.

src/LiveChartsCore/Drawing/BaseSankeyArc.reason: The sector of an arc node is measured into a retained path; the scene transition animates it.

src/LiveChartsCore/Drawing/BaseSankeyCho.reason: The chord ends and centre are measured into a retained path; the scene transition animates them.

src/LiveChartsCore/Drawing/BaseSankeyRib.reason: The ribbon ends are measured into a retained path; the scene transition animates them.

src/LiveChartsCore/Drawing/KeyFrame.cs.reason: Time, Value and destination easing semantics are preserved in a Rust value with an Rc closure.

src/LiveChartsCore/Easing/BackEasingFunc.reason: All in/out/in-out source formulas are preserved, including source boundary branches; f64 follows FerroUI numerical precision.

src/LiveChartsCore/Easing/BounceEasingFu.reason: All in/out/in-out source formulas are preserved, including source boundary branches; f64 follows FerroUI numerical precision.

src/LiveChartsCore/Easing/CircleEasingFu.reason: All in/out/in-out source formulas are preserved, including source boundary branches; f64 follows FerroUI numerical precision.

src/LiveChartsCore/Easing/CubicBezierEas.reason: The 257-sample LUT and bracketed Newton/bisection algorithm preserve source limits and identity shortcut, with finite-control validation and safe NaN sampling added.

src/LiveChartsCore/Easing/CubicEasingFun.reason: All in/out/in-out source formulas are preserved, including source boundary branches; f64 follows FerroUI numerical precision.

src/LiveChartsCore/Easing/ElasticEasingF.reason: All in/out/in-out source formulas are preserved, including source boundary branches; f64 follows FerroUI numerical precision.

src/LiveChartsCore/Easing/ExponentialEas.reason: All in/out/in-out source formulas are preserved, including source boundary branches; f64 follows FerroUI numerical precision.

src/LiveChartsCore/Easing/PolinominalEas.reason: All in/out/in-out source formulas are preserved, including source boundary branches; f64 follows FerroUI numerical precision.

src/LiveChartsCore/EasingFunctions.cs.reason: All predefined and parameterized easing functions plus keyframe composition are available as Rust functions/Rc closures. Ordered finite keyframe validation returns typed errors, and immutable Bezier presets are cached.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/ControlCoordinate.reason: The equirectangular projection with its default bounds of the whole earth, the normalized bounds (NaN to the default, an inverted pair swapped, an equal pair to the defaults; an infinite span too), the preferred ratio of the bounds, the projection and its linear inverse. Screen positions are f64 where the source uses float.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/DrawnMap.cs.reason: Named layers in the order they are added, a layer read from GeoJSON text with the default paints of the source (a new layer takes the given paints, an existing one keeps its own), and FindLand by key in the default layer.
remaining: The directory, stream and asynchronous loaders: a host reads the file and passes its text; the map has no Dispose (it is a value the chart only reads).

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/GeoJsonFeature.cs.reason: The type, properties and geometry of a feature are read from the serde_json value.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/GeoJsonFile.cs.reason: The feature collection is read with serde_json, as the source deserializes it with camel-case names.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/GeoJsonFileSource.reason: serde_json reads the camel-case names of the source serializer context.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/GeoTooltipPoint.c.reason: GeoLand carries the land of a hover or a click (its names, its screen bounds and the anchor of its tooltip) and GeoTooltipValue the value of each series that has one, in the order of the series; the heat colour is the fill of the land in the scene.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/GeoVisualElement..reason: A GeoMarker is a circle at a coordinate: projected through the projection, rotation and viewport on each measure, drawn above the map and hidden on the far side of a globe.
remaining: Other visuals than circles anchored at a coordinate, and their own location in the visual (the marker is centred on its coordinate).

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/IGeoMapTooltip.cs.reason: The native tooltip of the chart shows the land and its values at the anchor of the land.
remaining: A custom tooltip object of the application.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/IGeoMapView.cs.reason: The properties of the view are styled properties of the native chart with the source defaults: ActiveMap (None is the bundled world map), Stroke, Fill, MapProjection, the latitude and longitude bounds (None is the default of the projection, the source NaN), InteractionMode, ZoomingSpeed, MinZoomLevel and MaxZoomLevel; Series takes heat land series.
remaining: TooltipFormatter, and a custom Tooltip.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/IGeoSeries.cs.reason: A geo series is the engine HeatLandSeries (Name, IsVisible, TryGetValue) measured by the map engine; Delete has no counterpart in an immutable scene, which a removed series leaves.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/IHeatLandShape.cs.reason: The heat colour of a land is the fill of its primitives.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/IMapFactory.cs.reason: The factory of the lands is GeoMapChartEngine; Pan, Zoom and SetViewport are the viewport functions of MapViewport and the map methods of the chart.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/IWeigthedMapLand..reason: The notifying HeatLand model and the engine HeatLand carry the name and value.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/LandData.cs.reason: The coordinates of a ring, their bounds and the diagonal of the bounds; the drawn Shape and its Land are the primitives and hit regions of the retained scene.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/LandDefinition.cs.reason: The short name, name, set, bounds and rings of a land; the internal HSize and HCenter, unused by the source, have no counterpart.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/MapContext.cs.reason: The chart, map and projector of a measure are the arguments and result of GeoMapChartEngine::measure.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/MapInteractionMod.reason: None, Pan, Zoom and Both, a markup flags type of the controls.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/MapLayer.cs.reason: AddFile: Polygon and MultiPolygon features (a polygon a list of one, other types and features without coordinates skipped), the name, shortName and setOf properties lower-cased with the case-insensitive fallback, the feature_<index> name, every ring a land shape sorted by the diagonal of its bounds, and the <short name>_<index> key of a short name read twice. A malformed file is an error that leaves the layer as it was, where the source throws halfway through it. The unused Max, Min and AddLandWhen members have no counterpart.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/MapProjection.cs.reason: Default, Mercator and Orthographic, a markup enum of the core assembly.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/MapProjector.cs.reason: The abstract projector is the enum MapProjector of the three projections, with the map area, ToMap, IsVisible and ToCoordinates; the allocating array overload is the same projection.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/MapShapeContext.c.reason: The heat paint, stops and bounds of a series are computed in the measure of the series.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/Maps.cs.reason: The bundled world map, parsed once and shared, a map of one default layer from GeoJSON text, and BuildProjector, which fits the preferred ratio of the projection into the map area centred on the shorter side.
remaining: GetMapFromDirectory and the stream readers: a host reads the file and passes its text to map_from_geojson.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/MercatorProjector.reason: The Mercator projection with the asymmetric default crop of -65 to 85 degrees, the normalized bounds, the conformal preferred ratio, the projection with the extrapolation past the bounds that the chart clips, and the closed-form inverse. A latitude at a pole takes the last finite latitude (89.999999 degrees), so that the poles of a map stay finite where the source projects them to infinity.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/MultiPoligonGeome.reason: The type and raw coordinates of a geometry are read from the serde_json value.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/OrthographicProje.reason: The globe facing the centre coordinate: its radius of half the smaller side, its screen centre, the visibility of the near hemisphere, the projection, and the inverse of Snyder that rejects a position outside the disc.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/RotationTracker.c.reason: The animated centre of a globe is a rotation of the map animation of the chart, quadratic in and out over the given time, which writes CenterLongitude and CenterLatitude on each frame.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/ZoomOnPointerView.reason: The pivot and direction of a zoom are the arguments of Chart::zoom_map and MapViewport::zoomed.

src/LiveChartsCore/Geo/world.geojson.reason: The world map of the source, copied byte for byte (178,383 bytes) and embedded with include_str! as the source embeds it; the attribution is in the NOTICE.md of the crate.

src/LiveChartsCore/GeoMapChart.cs.reason: Measure: the title and legend room, a collapsed draw margin that hides the map, the projector fitted into the draw margin and the map clipped to its area, the visible layers, the heat of the series, the markers; FindLandAt with the values of every series and the anchor on the largest visible ring; BuildHitPoints with the screen bounds of the land; Project and Unproject through the viewport; Pan, Zoom, ResetViewport, BounceBack and RotateTo the short way round; a click on a land reported at the release within 5 pixels; the hover of the lands.
remaining: ViewTo, a no-op of the source factory; the heat legend sources (SKHeatLegend); the theme rules of the view; the tooltip throttling of 50 ms (the native hover is immediate).

src/LiveChartsCore/HeatFunctions.cs.reason: BuildColorStops (evenly spread or given offsets; fewer than two colours or offsets of another count an error where the source throws) and InterpolateColor (the position clamped to [0, 1], the channels truncated as the byte conversion). Where the source extrapolates before the first stop, divides by two stops at one offset or takes a NaN weight, the colour is the nearest stop.

src/LiveChartsCore/HorizontalBarSeries.c.reason: The shared Rust measurement pipeline implements orientation, bar grouping, pivot, signed stacks, range endpoints, errors, max width and exact-vs-category hover separation.
remaining: Generic visual/lifecycle template hooks and the complete source label placement/padding contract remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/Kernel/Coordinate.cs.reason: Six-dimensional immutable Rust value preserves explicit empty versus implicit default semantics, error values, constructor coordinate ordering and formatting. Overloaded constructors become named associated functions.

src/LiveChartsCore/Kernel/Drawing/Annula.reason: Annular containment respects the inner hole, radius, sweep sign, wraparound and full-circle spans.
remaining: Source tooltip-placement aggregation and full hover-class API remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/Kernel/Drawing/Bezier.reason: Six coordinate components use a copied Rust value; FerroUI Point accessors replace graphics-layer projections.

src/LiveChartsCore/Kernel/Drawing/LineSp.reason: Seed and segment calculations preserve source operation order, f32 segment-length ratios, and the upstream signed stack-offset expression. FerroUI Point replaces source LvcPoint.

src/LiveChartsCore/Kernel/Drawing/Rectan.reason: Normalized hover bounds distinguish painted geometry from category discovery; all closest strategies choose within each series, and zero-area plots reject interactions.
remaining: All source SuggestedTooltipLocation/placement aggregation methods are not modeled one-to-one.

src/LiveChartsCore/Kernel/Drawing/Semici.reason: Annular containment respects the inner hole, radius, sweep sign, wraparound and full-circle spans.
remaining: Source tooltip-placement aggregation and full hover-class API remain pending.

src/LiveChartsCore/Kernel/Error.cs.reason: Four directional error components and the explicit Empty marker retain source defaults; symmetric construction is an additional convenience.

src/LiveChartsCore/Kernel/Extensions.cs.reason: Cartesian and polar tick calculation is ported with rotated-label, density, unit-width and minimum-separator logic. Degenerate input gets a finite fallback and loop iterations are bounded.
remaining: Other source extension methods are not mapped by this contribution.

src/LiveChartsCore/Kernel/Sketches/ISank.reason: The native SankeyChart is a Chart of the kind Sankey.

The properties of the interface (NodeWidth, NodePadding, NodeCornerRadius, LayoutIterations, NodeLabelPosition, Layout, ArcSpanDegrees, LinkFill) are styled properties of the native SankeySeries with the source defaults; SankeyLabelPosition and SankeyLayoutKind are the enums of the engine.

src/LiveChartsCore/Kernel/Sketches/ITree.reason: The native TreemapChart is a Chart of the kind Treemap.
Padding (2 by default) and CornerRadius are the shared properties of the native TreemapSeries; the total weight and the assigned rectangle are computed by the engine.

src/LiveChartsCore/Kernel/StackedValue.c.reason: Copied value carries positive, negative and cumulative tracks, including the sign-dependent Share formula.

src/LiveChartsCore/Kernel/Stacker.cs.reason: The source category stacking algorithm uses caller-provided unique series IDs and copied Coordinates. Rust HashMap keys canonicalize NaN and signed zero like Double.Equals. MaxLength reports actual maximum row length (upstream remains zero); invalid stack positions are rejected; get_stack supplies the coordinate sign for Share.

src/LiveChartsCore/Measure/AxisLimit.cs.reason: Source sentinel defaults, explicit user pinning, scaling and validation are preserved.

src/LiveChartsCore/Measure/AxisOrientati.reason: Source Unknown, X and Y variants are retained.

src/LiveChartsCore/Measure/AxisPosition..reason: All source enum alternatives are explicit Rust variants and registered FerroUI markup values.

src/LiveChartsCore/Measure/AxisTick.cs.reason: Source Value and Magnitude use f64 values. Calculation helpers are also supplied.

src/LiveChartsCore/Measure/Bounds.cs.reason: Extrema, empty/default behavior, metadata aggregation, delta, and copying retain source behavior. Copy and Clone replace the copy constructor.

src/LiveChartsCore/Measure/DimensionalBo.reason: All six bounds and initial minimum-limits behavior are preserved without nullable owned bounds.

src/LiveChartsCore/Measure/FindingStrate.reason: All source enum alternatives are explicit Rust variants and registered FerroUI markup values.

src/LiveChartsCore/Measure/PolarLabelsPo.reason: All source enum alternatives are explicit Rust variants and registered FerroUI markup values.

src/LiveChartsCore/Measure/PolarScaler.c.reason: Forward zero-origin angular convention and source radial scaling are retained using FerroUI Point/Rect. Inverse uses atan2 and signed revolution normalization, deliberately correcting upstream axis singularities and extra MinAngle; invalid/collapsed ranges return errors.

src/LiveChartsCore/Measure/RadialAlignme.reason: All source enum alternatives are explicit Rust variants and registered FerroUI markup values.

src/LiveChartsCore/Measure/Scaler.cs.reason: Affine conversion, Y inversion, explicit inversion and collapsed-slope behavior use a value-based constructor with Result errors. Numeric precision is f64; sentinel limits are normalized before inversion, correcting the source reversed validation arguments for an empty X range. An explicit logarithmic constructor replaces subclass specialization.

src/LiveChartsCore/Motion/ByReferenceMot.reason: Noninterpolated reference values use Discrete<T>, snap to target and mark completion on sampling without synthetic object ownership.

src/LiveChartsCore/Motion/ColorMotionPro.reason: Generic Interpolate and MotionProperty specialize the source interpolation formula and transition eligibility using FerroUI value types; optional values and changed-length arrays snap to their destination.

src/LiveChartsCore/Motion/DoubleMotionPr.reason: Generic Interpolate and MotionProperty specialize the source interpolation formula and transition eligibility using FerroUI value types; optional values and changed-length arrays snap to their destination.

src/LiveChartsCore/Motion/FloatArrayMoti.reason: Generic Interpolate and MotionProperty specialize the source interpolation formula and transition eligibility using FerroUI value types; optional values and changed-length arrays snap to their destination.

src/LiveChartsCore/Motion/FloatMotionPro.reason: Generic Interpolate and MotionProperty specialize the source interpolation formula and transition eligibility using FerroUI value types; optional values and changed-length arrays snap to their destination.

src/LiveChartsCore/Motion/IMotionPropert.reason: Typed MotionProperty methods cover sampling, retargeting, completion and animation configuration; the source object-erased registry interface is not reproduced.
remaining: Review source property-registry operations against the native control system.

src/LiveChartsCore/Motion/MotionProperty.reason: Retargeting, exact endpoint completion timing, phase-continuous overshoot, finite/infinite repeats, completion and snapping use explicit caller timestamps. Invalid times snap safely. Source object invalidation and registered completion callbacks are not provided by this generic numeric value.
remaining: Animatable property registry, per-property OnCompleted callbacks and source reflection/debug hooks require separate native integration.

src/LiveChartsCore/Motion/NullableDouble.reason: Generic Interpolate and MotionProperty specialize the source interpolation formula and transition eligibility using FerroUI value types; optional values and changed-length arrays snap to their destination.

src/LiveChartsCore/Motion/PaddingMotionP.reason: Generic Interpolate and MotionProperty specialize the source interpolation formula and transition eligibility using FerroUI value types; optional values and changed-length arrays snap to their destination.

src/LiveChartsCore/Motion/PointMotionPro.reason: Generic Interpolate and MotionProperty specialize the source interpolation formula and transition eligibility using FerroUI value types; optional values and changed-length arrays snap to their destination.

src/LiveChartsCore/Motion/SizeMotionProp.reason: Generic Interpolate and MotionProperty specialize the source interpolation formula and transition eligibility using FerroUI value types; optional values and changed-length arrays snap to their destination.

src/LiveChartsCore/PieChartEngine.cs.reason: Native retained scenes measure category-keyed pie totals, concentric values and gauges; background fill series are excluded from hover; chart size, rotation, range, direction and explicit margins are preserved.
remaining: Source per-point animation entry/deletion lifecycle and event dispatch are replaced only in part by native scene transitions.
All source chart measuring/tooltip placement contracts have not received direct upstream test counterparts.

src/LiveChartsCore/PolarChartEngine.cs.reason: The polar engine measures independent angle and radius axes, the empty and zero-width bounds, the series padding, the automatic margin of the angle labels, an explicit draw margin and the fit-to-bounds plot into a retained scene; the native PolarChart hosts it with the title and legend layout.
remaining: Tooltips, legends and visual elements of the source chart view, and its animated frame lifecycle, are the native host's; the polar axis name labels are not drawn.

src/LiveChartsCore/SankeyChartEngine.cs.reason: The Sankey engine measures every visible series in the whole draw margin (title, legend or an explicit margin), hides a collapsed plot, and draws the series with the paint order of the source; the native SankeyChart hosts it.
remaining: Tooltips, legends and visual elements of the source chart view, and its animated frame lifecycle, are the native host's.

src/LiveChartsCore/SankeyLayout.cs.reason: The d3-sankey vertical layout and the bipartite arc layout: the node and link filtering of the source (repeated nodes, self-loops, unknown ends, nonpositive or non-finite weights), Kahn depths with the cycle error, node values, the column scale, the alternating relaxation sweeps and collision passes, the band order of the links, the arc sweeps with the angular padding and the chord ends, and the error on multi-column data. Positions are f64 where the source uses float; equal positions keep their order (a stable sort).

src/LiveChartsCore/SankeyMeasureContext..reason: The draw rectangle, node width, padding and iterations reach the layout as arguments of the measurement, which has no per-frame context object.

src/LiveChartsCore/TreemapChartEngine.cs.reason: The treemap engine squarifies the draw margin between the visible series by their totals (a series without a slot takes the whole margin), hides a collapsed plot and draws the tiles with the paint order of the source; the native TreemapChart hosts it.
remaining: Tooltips, legends and visual elements of the source chart view, and its animated frame lifecycle, are the native host's.

src/LiveChartsCore/TreemapLayout.cs.reason: The squarified layout: invalid weights skipped, descending order, the greedy rows by the worst aspect ratio along the shorter side. The weights are normalised by the largest, which keeps the areas without the overflow of the source near f64::MAX, and a collapsed remainder places the rest at zero size instead of dividing by zero.

src/LiveChartsCore/TreemapMeasureContext.reason: The assigned rectangle, padding and corner radius reach the layout as arguments of the measurement, which has no per-frame context object.

src/LiveChartsCore/VerticalBarSeries.cs.reason: The shared Rust measurement pipeline implements orientation, bar grouping, pivot, signed stacks, range endpoints, errors, max width and exact-vs-category hover separation.
remaining: Generic visual/lifecycle template hooks and the complete source label placement/padding contract remain pending.

src/skiasharp/LiveChartsCore.SkiaSharp/D.reason: Classic and rounded/inverted doughnut outlines become FerroUI cubic path commands, with tangent arcs and quarter-circle segmentation; actual Pushout is applied to geometry and hit coordinates.
remaining: Tiny-wedge corner limiting and exact full-circle closure intentionally differ from the upstream fallback.
This replaces native backend drawing; source Skia snapshot equality has not been established.

src/skiasharp/LiveChartsCore.SkiaSharp/D.reason: A notifying land with its Name and Value.

A ring of a land is a polygon primitive of the retained scene, transformed by the viewport (the stroke scaled by the zoom, as the canvas matrix of the source scales it), and its hit test is the polygon of the hit region; the native renderer draws it on the GPU path of every backend.
MapViewport: the zoom about the centre of the control and the pan, its transform, its inverse and whether it is the identity.
The annular sector of a node, not drawn without a sweep; the corner radius rounds the four corners as the corner path effect of the source does.
The same untwisted band: cubics through the centre and the inner arc along each band in its shorter direction, as cubic arcs for the native renderer.
The same S-curve band, with its control points at the horizontal middle, drawn by the native renderer.

src/skiasharp/LiveChartsCore.SkiaSharp/H.reason: The native HeatLandSeries, a generated ChartSeries of the kind HeatLand with its lands and the default heat map of the source constructors.
